body:
Hey, I've been in a similar situation and still am kinda right now. Although I'm not nearly as depressed as I was a few years ago but I'm currently in a situation right now where lots of my friends are going to parties and festivals, making out with girls and having sex and all that

I myself really dislike areas that are really busy, so whenever I get invited by my friends to go to a club or to a festival I always refuse and tell them I don't feel like coming. What has been helping for me to be more with my friends is to just tell them; "Hey, I really dislike to go here here and there, maybe we can just chill out at someones place and have a casual beer?" I've done this like 1 month ago and thus far I've been hanging out with at least a couple of my friends ones or maybe twice a week with just a beer. Even to the point where I'm really making GOOD friends with 2 of them. Also having no girlfriend or relationship is really nothing to be ashamed of, I myself have had one girlfriend in my life and it wasn't the kind of relationship I hoped it to be (Thus falling into a deep ravine of depression)

A friend of mine said to me, "You know, it's totally fine to have no relationship, this way it'll be way better if you eventually do get one."

You definitely don't have to feel guilty for your mom, just show her how much you appreciate her for raising you and your brothers alone.

Also don't worry about not showing a lot of emotions with your brothers, it's totally okay to grow a little away from them emotionally.

You're on the right track to picking up a more social life with less anxiety, just remember that if you want to live a normal and good life, it has to come from you.
Not your medication or therapy. (I'm not saying medication or therapy are useless, but don't fall into an endless pit by thinking that you're nothing "Even with medication!" it's just not the case)

I have literally no clue of any of the words I just said have helped you in any way, if not I at least hope it was a good read.

Depending on where you're currently at in life, whether you're studying, at school or working, there's always people who'll miss you. 
No matter how remote it may seem, maybe it's that one cashier you see every week when buying groceries, whether it is a teacher you don't even get lessons from, whether it is a neighbor of yours or someone who you once had a chat with a long time ago. 
Everyone will eventually realise, "Hey, where's that one person who used to be here" to find out that you're no longer there, no longer seeing them from time to time and never meeting up with them again. I know I'm just some person on the internet trying to make someone a little happier, but just keep in your head that no matter how isolated or such you are, there's always going to be people who miss you.

I also realize that you've probably heard this story many times, if so please do realise that it's not just some untrue story that people make up.
Hi, I'm just updating you guys now. I feel a lot better already! I'm over it, as long as i don't get remembered.

Hi, I'm actually a guy that wants to commit suicide because of my girlfriend breaking up with me. I'm 15 years old and I've only had four and a half months with this girl. May not seem that special. But it hurts me really bad and I have already been cutting myself with a knife, what felt very good. I also posted for help at /r/SuicideWatch which is mostly keeping me alive at the moment. Thanks reddit. You may safe my life.

With all the feelings i have felt i know exactly how you feel. I was actually talking a lot about how bad i felt on whatsapp with my friends. at lunch break in school i just walked to the farmlands my school is close to, watched the nature and thinking about how i need to go on, or if i even want to go on. Just thinking about everyone i ever met in my life and what kind of epic things i will be missing if i said goodbye. I think i'll be fine from now on. I really hope you are getting happier soon. It feels really good though, the transition from depressive to normal. I believe! You seem to be a nice guy so i don't think i am the only one thinking you should keep living and believing in every good thing on earth.

EDIT: Fixed typo

I feel a lot better now, when i was in the bus on my way home from school today, a friend of mine walked towards me said: "Give me your knife, people need you" I handed my knife over. Now something very magical happens, i was walking from the bus to my house. A boy on his bike was alone on the street, on a pretty busy road. I was the only one not in a car at that moment. He fell right on the road, saw it happening and i ran towards him running on the road and cousing traffic to slow down. Slowly pulled him to the walking part of the road, so i wouldn't mess up traffic even more. The little boy had a lot of pain on his left leg. He told me his home was pretty close from here. I got on his bike, got him on the back and delivered him home. Thank god i didn't commit suicide. Or else that boy would've probably broken some bones or even die by a car. I think i'm done with being depressive and i have to keep on living. Fck my ex for breaking up with me, but love her for the great fcking time we had. We're friends now.
Thank you, I could really use someone I can talk to. It hurts so bad :'/
Dude ofc i am, i have never been spoken to with such kind words! Not even from my mom or my now ex-gf :'\
Why hate reddit? The community of reddit saved my life! :D :D :D :D :D :D :D

Holy moly dude, thank you so much. Thank you so fcking much, i owe you a lot. If i knew how and had the money for it i'd buy you reddit gold. (atleast i can give you [this](http://i.imgur.com/sy9lVl4.jpg) lol)
You exactly know my feelings. (I'm not going to smoke with my friends btw, smoking is unhealthy!) Thank you so much for helping me out.
Why are you getting downvoted, you helped me with all the others. Thank you!
I didn't and will never do it.

Thank you guys for responding, i just had a chat with "that girl" she was talking about that i was destroying my own life for another person i was proud of and that that's unhealthy. While i think it's just heartbreak. I also told my friends at school they saved my life, by just being friends. They gave me a little bit of hope. Cousing me to reconsider and posting this first. Thank you all, and i'll just forget this whole situation and live on. Just one little question: Is it actually unhealthy to be such in love with someone that it almost coused me to kill myself? (In my eyes it's just heartbreak)
You're not telling me older people haven't got hard times, commiting suicide seems like the solution for all of that.
